SelectorQuery

Query node objects.

Method

SelectorQuery SelectorQuery.in(Component component)

Change the selection scope of the selector to the custom component.

NodesRef SelectorQuery.select(string selector)

Select the first node that matches the selector on the current page. A NodesRef object instance is returned, which can be used to obtain node information.

NodesRef SelectorQuery.selectAll(string selector)

Select all nodes that match the selector on the current page.

NodesRef SelectorQuery.selectViewport()

Select the display area. It can be used to obtain the size and scrolling position of the display area.

NodesRef SelectorQuery.exec(function callback)

Execute all requests. The request results form an array based on the request sequence and are returned in the first parameter of callback.
